:::{#exr-matrix-column-practice}
#### Reading off a column of a matrix

When each [row of a matrix](#def-matrix-row) records one observation,
each [column](#def-matrix-column) holds one measured quantity for every observation,
so reading off a column extracts that quantity's values.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 & -1 \\ 5 & 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find $\matr{A}_{:,2}$, the second [column of $\matr{A}$](#def-matrix-column).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

The $j$th [column of an $m \times n$ matrix](#def-matrix-column) lists the entries $a_{1j}, \ldots, a_{mj}$ from top to bottom,
as in @exm-matrix-rows-columns.

:::
